title: Jose-Luis Bazan
name: José-Luis Bazán
html: José-Luis Bazán is a legal advisor for Migration and Asylum and Religious Freedom and Secretary of the the Commission of the Bishops’ Conferences of the European Union (COMECE) Working Group on Migration and Asylum.
